About the atlas

One motif, many methods.

The illustrations are generated studies. Repeating the pear helps isolate what changes from one approach to another, from the way a page is laid out to how an ink mark lands on paper.

How to read the index

A movement places work in a historical context. A style describes how it looks. A medium or technique describes how it is made. One design can combine all three.
